remarks:
Welcome to easy Lake Erie living in this fully furnished, FIRST-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located in a beautiful 50-acre lakefront community in Westfield, NY. From your own private enclosed patio/porch, enjoy picturesque views of Lake Erie and a peaceful setting that is perfect for morning coffee, relaxing, or entertaining guests.
The thoughtfully designed layout begins with a welcoming hallway flanked by two bedrooms, offering privacy and functionality. The bedroom on the left features a full bathroom, while the bedroom on the right provides convenient access to a stackable washer and dryer. A second full bathroom is located across from the galley-style kitchen, which includes a breakfast bar for casual dining.
The hallway opens into a spacious living room and dining area, where large lake views create a beautiful backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. An in-wall air conditioner provides added comfort during warmer months.
This condo is part of a desirable 50-acre lakefront community with approximately 2,500 feet of shoreline, offering an exceptional collection of amenities. Enjoy access to a private beach, fitness center, laundry facilities, playground, recreation room, basketball court, and dog park. The community's in-ground pool is currently being refurbished and redone, adding even more appeal to this already impressive property.
Association fees include cable, internet, snow removal, and trash removal, making this an ideal low-maintenance property.

Whether you're looking for a fully furnished vacation getaway, seasonal retreat, or year-round residence, this Lake Erie condo offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, beautiful views, and resort-style community amenities.
